def factor_range_pressure_excess_downside(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # primary mechanism: cycle range pressure over 60 days
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # lightweight modifier: excess downside volume participation above neutral 0.5
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    excess_down = (down_ratio - 0.5).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.5)
    attenuation = 1.0 - excess_down
    factor = range_pressure * attenuation
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_excess_downside"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_excess_downside"]

Bottleneck: raw IC=0.0178 and RankIC=0.0170 are held back because the parent attenuates range_pressure by absolute down_ratio even when downside volume is neutral near 0.5, reducing signal strength in normal regimes. This mutation adjusts the modifier to excess downside participation above 0.5: only abnormal downside volume dominance attenuates the signal, while balanced or upside regimes preserve full range-pressure strength. This is a compact direction adjustment of the existing modifier, keeping one core cycle-range-pressure mechanism and one lightweight continuous modifier, with cross-sectional transform none to preserve raw payoff structure.
